name: analytics-demo-web
title: Web analytics demo data
description: Demo data, loader and live step for the SheenUI web analytics dashboard. Not needed in production.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Web analytics demo data: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/dashboards/web-analytics

Installed in components/sheenui/blocks/analytics/. Import (use your components alias):
import { webAnalyticsDemoData, webAnalyticsDemoLoader, webLiveStep } from "@/components/sheenui/blocks/analytics/demo-web";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
